release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.5 Directional Plan Layers, Vortex-BT-ID Default Block & 64-Bit Clean Upgrades:
• 64-Bit Program Files Installation: Modernized installer default directory to 64-bit Program Files, eliminating unnecessary administrator elevation prompts on x86 paths.
• Seamless Automated Upgrade Uninstallation: Installer automatically detects and cleanly uninstalls previous versions before installing new binaries, while preserving user settings and customized template blocks in %APPDATA%/VortexPT.
• Directional Plan Layers for Plan X & Plan Y: Distinct dedicated layers for Plan X (Latitude) and Plan Y (Longitude) chairs, control points, dimensions, tags, jacks, and dead ends (S-PT-CHAIRS-HIGH-X/Y, S-PT-CHAIRS-INT-X/Y, S-DIM-CHAIRS-X/Y, S-DIM-SPACING-X/Y, S-PT-TAGS-X/Y, S-PT-JACKS-X/Y, S-PT-DEAD-ENDS-X/Y).
• Default Tendon ID Block 'Vortex-BT-ID': Updated default tendon ID block name to Vortex-BT-ID with automated template cloning and directional support.
• Clean Window Title Bar: Removed redundant version number from the main application title bar.
